prompt: Our support desk relies on the triageTier helper in src/triage-tier.mjs to pick a handling tier for incoming tickets. Yesterday a ticket that had been idle for 90 minutes, with trip points of 30 (priority) and 60 (immediate), came back tagged routine, so it sat unanswered in the general inbox. The regression test in tests/triage-tier.test.mjs reproduces the bug: npm test fails before the fix and should pass after it.
